events.text: Alfonso Carlos Comín Ros was born in Zaragoza.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Alfonso Carlos Comín Ros ( 1933 in Zaragoza

events.text: Alfonso Carlos Comín Ros died in Barcelona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 23 July 1980 in Barcelona

events.text: He joined the Popular Liberation Front (FLP).
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1956 , he joined the Popular Liberation Front

events.text: He abandoned the Popular Liberation Front to join the Workers Front of Catalonia (FOC).
events.subject: self
events.quote: abandoned it in 1962 to join the Workers Front of Catalonia

events.text: He joined the Organización Comunista de España (Bandera Roja).
events.subject: self
events.object: Organización Comunista de España ( Bandera Roja )
events.quote: In 1970 , he joined the Organización Comunista de España ( Bandera Roja )

events.text: He created the Christians for Socialism movement together with Joan N. García-Nieto.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1973 , he created the Christians for Socialism movement together with Joan N . García-Nieto

events.text: He founded the Bandera Roja de Catalunya.
events.subject: self
events.quote: left it to found the Bandera Roja de Catalunya ( Red Flag of Catalonia ) in 1974

events.text: He was elected as a representative to the Parliament of Catalonia for the Province of Barcelona on behalf of the PSUC.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1980 , he was elected as a representative to the Parliament of Catalonia

events.text: He became the editor of the periodical Taula de Canvi.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was the editor of the periodical Taula de Canvi from 1976 until his death

events.text: His editorship of Taula de Canvi ended with his death.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was the editor of the periodical Taula de Canvi from 1976 until his death

events.text: His political heirs founded the Fundació Alfons Comín in his memory.
